text: Farmers, friends, companions of the sod, we will not be sombrous and down-hearted, because, forsooth, it may hap that we now close the gates upon our pathway, and no more, after this, walk together in our pleasant companionship. . . . We have ploughed, we have sowed, we have reapt, we have mowed; we have enjoyed the fruits of our industry, and relished the good things of life in health and thankfulness. . . . Let there be nothing morose and chilly in parting.
